saw_lines: Hair topper buyers hide thinning, so they choose by how undetectable it looks and whether it matches their own hair.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the ad shows the result or gets scrolled past.
Your site shows 50,000+ customers and 822 reviews, but none of your 30 ads use them. Put the 50,000+ figure on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 50,000+ customers and 822 reviews, but none of your 30 ads use them. Buyers need proof before they trust the fit, so gaps lose sales. Print 50,000+ on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers percent off, yet 0 of 27 ads mention it or any offer. A first buyer has no reason to act today. Put the percent off in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

All 27 of your copy ads open on the same “stop trying everything except the” line, so new buyers see one story only. Name two or three new angles from your product, like the Silk Topper, and run them against it.

Your site has a shipping guide, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping. Buyers ask how a topper arrives before they click, so the question stalls the sale. Open new buyer ads with free shipping on all wigs and toppers.

ads_1: Review-led topper creative with percent off, tested against the current opener.
